title: Four Yellow Armored Figures
description: Four identical miniature figures of a muscular male character with messy blonde hair, wearing black and yellow futuristic armored suits with large shoulder pads and gauntlets. They are posed in a repeated walking stance from left to right against a dark gradient background.
prompt: Four identical views of a stocky, muscular male character with messy spiky blonde hair and an angry expression, wearing heavy black and bright yellow futuristic armor with oversized shoulder pads, knee guards, and gauntlets. The figures are shown in a dynamic walking pose with clenched fists, arranged side by side in a row on a dark studio background, highly detailed painted miniature style.
